question: Fort Saint Louis was a ______ fort that stood in Pondicherry on the eastern coast of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**French.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Fort Saint Louis was a **French** fort that stood in Pondicherry on the eastern coast of India.
 
• Fort Saint Louis was built around **1701.**
 
• It was built by **Francois Martin** and completed posthumously around 1706.
 
• The fort's heart was marked by a citadel.
 
• The fort had a pentagonal shape and was designed by an engineer named de Nyon.
